claims.claim: Clean and good to shoot videos and snapshots.
claims.evidence: photo 0 shows the camera and lenses appear physically presentable, but there is no proof of video capability, autofocus performance, or sensor cleanliness.

risks.risk: Exact camera model is unknown; pricing varies a lot by Nikon DSLR generation (e.g., D3xxx vs D5xxx) and features (video quality, usability).
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of the camera model name/number on the body (e.g., D3xxx/D5xxx) and the rear screen showing menu/about.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic Nikon DSLR kit with unknown model, worst-case for value (older/lower-tier body).

risks.risk: Lens exact models/condition are not fully readable; could be different focal lengths or non-matching/third-party lenses.
risks.proof: Ask for close-up photos of both lens nameplates showing the full model text (e.g., AF-S NIKKOR 18-55mm ... and 50mm ...), plus front and rear element close-ups.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a basic 18-55 kit lens + a generic 50mm prime, assuming possible wear and no guarantee of perfect optics.

risks.risk: Sensor dust/scratches and internal issues cannot be confirmed from one photo.
risks.proof: Ask for a test shot of a blank white wall at f/16 (or similar) and a short video clip showing focus and exposure.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed for clean sensor/consistent performance (worst-case: needs cleaning or has dust).

risks.risk: Shutter count / mechanical health is unknown; could be near end-of-life.
risks.proof: Ask for a screenshot/photo from a shutter count app or the camera’s shutter count info (or a service report).
risks.if_unproven: Price as higher wear (worst-case: significant shutter usage).

risks.risk: Missing accessories (battery, charger, memory card, straps, caps) are not shown.
risks.proof: Ask for a full contents photo laid out: battery, charger, both lens caps, body cap (if any), strap, and any cables.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming missing/uncertain accessories and no extras.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the exact Nikon DSLR model number on the body (and a rear-screen “About/Model” page).
Close-up photos of both lenses showing full markings/model text (18-55 and 50mm) and front/rear element condition.
A sample photo test (white wall at small aperture) to check sensor dust/scratches.
A short video test clip showing autofocus and stabilization (if applicable).
Photo of all included accessories (battery, charger, caps, strap, memory card if included).
response.reason: From photo 0, it’s clearly a Nikon DSLR kit with two lenses, but the exact camera model and lens markings aren’t readable, and there’s no functional proof (sensor, autofocus, video). Without that, a reliable worst-case price can’t be set.
